items.title: Kimco Realty (KIM) Acquires Two Louisville Shopping Centers For $295 Million
items.summary: Kimco Realty (NYSE:KIM) agreed to acquire two grocery-anchored shopping centers in Louisville for US$295 million. The centers are described as prominent and located in a supply constrained Louisville retail market with high occupancy. Management is using capital recycling for the purchase, targeting remerchandising and below market rents as income growth levers.
